# FlowForm

> A form endpoint in 30 seconds. Grow into multi-step workflows without switching tools.

FlowForm is an open-source, dual-licensed (AGPLv3 core, MIT SDKs and starter kits) form endpoint and multi-step workflow engine:
- **HTML Form Endpoints (`POST /f/{slug}` or `POST /api/v1/f/{slug}`):** Drop-in backend for HTML, Astro, Next.js, Hugo, and WordPress sites with built-in `_gotcha` honeypot protection, Allowed Domains validation, full-URL `_next` redirects, database persistence, and HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks (`X-FlowForm-Signature-256`).
- **Multi-Step Conditional Workflows:** Upgrade any endpoint to versioned JSON schemas (`GET /api/v1/forms/{uuid}/schema`), step persistence (`POST /api/v1/public/submissions`), and server-validated conditional branching without changing tools.
- **AI Agents & APIs:** OpenAPI v1 spec, scoped Sanctum bearer tokens (`forms:read`, `submissions:read`, `webhooks:manage`), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) docs.
